top_signals.title: Solar Has Overtaken Nuclear in the Global Power Mix
top_signals.summary: Last year, solar power quietly overtook nuclear power in the global energy mix. This is a stunning feat when you consider that just a decade ago, in 2015, global solar generation amounted to just 256 terawatt-hours (TWh)  in 2015, while global nuclear power generated ten-fold that amount at 2,576 TWh.
